iPhone Standby-Modus-Dock (entwickelt mit OVERWERK)

https://makerworld.com/de/models/615378-iphone-standby-mode-dock-designed-with-overwerk#profileId-538769

This was designed for the iPhone 15 Pro in collaboration with OVERWERK. 

Watch the project video for details:

 

This 3D model is not for commercial use. If you don't have a 3D printer, pre-order is available here: https://store.overwerk.com/products/dock

 

DISCLAIMER: Please be careful when ejecting your iPhone. Always have your thumb down or other fingers in the way ready to catch it as demonstrated in the video.

 

SEE THE VIDEO DESCRIPTION ON YOUTUBE FOR THE EXACT MATERIALS AND TOOLS USED.

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, 8% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 8%
- Filament: PLA (#FFFFFF)
